# include/blender/trace_viewer Documentation

*This file is automatically generated by merging README files from multiple branches.*

## From branch: codex/create-readme-for-trace_viewer-2025-06-22


This directory contains the `TraceViewer` header used to inspect the evolution of patterns managed by `PatternProcessor`. The class offers a lightweight console viewer and depends only on pattern headers.

Although placed under the Blender integration tree, the code has no Blender-specific ties. If additional visualization utilities are developed, consider moving this folder into a shared `visualization` module so non-Blender frontends can reuse it.
